verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no bulk export of traces or datasets to blob storage or a data warehouse. The Service API REST endpoints, including /calls/stream_query, are only a programmatic query primitive a developer could build an export pipeline on, not the export capability itself. OTel support covers importing traces into Weave, not exporting them out.

support.subject: As a developer, I can bulk-export traces and datasets to blob storage or my data warehouse
